policy: Fixed before the ParagraphIR PoC is written (issue #124): 6 of the 16 cases of issue #122, three the current approach refuses, one it saves without practical success, two practical controls. No case is added, removed or replaced by a fixture afterwards. A missing input is not run, never a success.
current: B2: the committed results (every listed candidate approved). pdfeditor paths (propose-page with the paragraph lines selected, accept-page, replace-text; edit-paragraph) are run on the same cases after freezing, with their manual inputs recorded.

sequence.what: click + selection -> ParagraphIR, once, from the source PDF
the case edit (old -> new) on the IR; written back to PDF 1
on the same IR (no re-import): new -> old; written back to PDF 2 from the source
on the same IR: undo E2 then E1; the IR equals the imported one (text, runs, layout)
PDF 1 alone: a fresh import from PDF 1 (no IR state), new -> old; written to PDF 3

conditions: saved: the paragraph text after the edit is drawn where the IR lays it out (MuPDF, whitespace aside)

protection (outside the paragraph): every source glyph not owned by the IR at its origin; drawings, images, annotations, links, other pages unchanged; no pixel differing outside the paragraph area (MuPDF 72/150 dpi, Poppler 72 dpi)
structure: no MCID lost; on a tagged page the new text inside the paragraph's marked content; optional-content membership kept
search and copy: search_copy.verified (issues #114/#116; as_in_source never passes)
appearance: the original font resource (no substitute font); size and colour kept
placement: lines on the IR's baselines, at the paragraph's left edge (or centre for centered text)
practical = all of the above; a check not made is null and never a success (docs/development-rules.md, docs/practical-search.md unchanged)
approvals: growth into empty space inside the paragraph's container only, approved per edit; nothing else
refusal: an unapproved change, a collision, a lost glyph or broken structure is refused before anything is written (the output is not created, an existing one untouched)
counted apart: E1 saved / practical, IR re-edit (E2), undo, PDF-alone re-edit, restore (E2 and alone equal the source: page text and pixels), refusal
